Google rolls out Gemini 4 Neon, with "fast end-to-end task completion" across coding, knowledge work, and science, in the API, Antigravity, and the Gemini app (Koray Kavukcuoglu/Google)
DNI, DHS, and FBI officials tell Congress they have found no evidence that recent US tech outages were connected to each other or caused by cyberattacks (Nicole Sganga/CBS News)
Meta agrees to pause issuing nonvoting Class C shares during lawsuits by investors opposing its plan to fund AI investments without diluting Zuckerberg's stake (Sabrina Willmer/Bloomberg)
Palo Alto Networks agrees to buy Applied Compute, which helps companies customize open-weight AI models, for $4.5B in stock; it was valued at $3.25B this month (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)
Sources: Bret Taylor's Sierra is in talks to raise ~$1.5B at a ~$30B valuation, up from $15.8B in May; it said in October it hit $400M+ in annualized revenue (The Information)
Google rebrands its Gemini Spark AI agent as Tasks and makes it free in six countries; in the US it can call businesses and buy items with Google Pay (Emma Roth/The Verge)
At Nvidia's first all-hands since Huang's ouster, Colette Kress told staff that they can expect pay raises and more equity in December, months ahead of schedule (Wired)
Google rolls out Project Genie updates to AI Ultra subscribers, including Genie 4, new Genie 3 features, an agent to build worlds, and a gallery to share them (Google)
Gavin Newsom unveils a proposal to give California broad powers to regulate the AI industry, but stops short of requiring the development of kill switches (Politico)
Paris-based Remanence, which helps companies train and fine-tune open-weight AI models, raised a $30M seed led by EQT Ventures and FirstMark (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
Sources: Anthropic is weighing upsizing its IPO, setting the price well above $80, up from its price range of $70-$78 per share, as investor demand surges (CNBC)
Ukraine is using a network of drones as airborne communication relays after repeated Starlink disruptions, including during a strike on Russia's Kerch Bridge (Financial Times)
Cybersecurity company Xint says it found RCE vulnerabilities in Nginx using GPT 6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna; Wiz says it had separately found the same flaws (Thomas Brewster/Forbes)
Variational, which offers blockchain-based derivatives tied to cryptocurrencies and traditional assets, raised a $110M Series B at a $1.5B valuation (Jason Shubnell/The Block)
Ahead of Anthropic's IPO, CAIS and others sign the MisAnthropic Statement, challenging the company's "safety" branding and its "reckless attempt" to build RSI (Center for AI Safety)
